item.title: Iran’s nuclear policy unchanged; deterrence debate natural after attacks on nuclear sites: Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s nuclear policy remains clear, and discussions about nuclear deterrence are not unusual after repeated attacks and acts of sabotage targeting the country’s nuclear facilities, Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei says, rejecting claims that Tehran has changed its nuclear doctrine or is considering withdrawal from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT).

item.title: Oman meeting called off at Saudi Arabia’s request: Tehran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei says a planned meeting of the foreign ministers of regional countries in Oman was canceled at Saudi Arabia’s request, adding that Iran and Oman have finalized an understanding on maritime routes and will decide with Muscat how to announce it.
